title: neoholstia sessiliflora
intro: Neoholstia sessiliflora, commonly known as Asian coral tree, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Neoholstia sessiliflora include analgesic, antipyretic, and antiseptic properties, which make it effective in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Neoholstia sessiliflora include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
